snippet.title: Luce Spenta | Definitive Trailer
snippet.description:
The lights have gone out once more.

Five souls still wait beyond the grave.
Their stories remain unchanged.
But the path leading to them has become clearer than ever.

Luce Spenta returns with fully reworked visuals, enhanced cinematics, and a refined atmosphere, bringing the world of judgment closer to what it was always meant to be.

I will guide you through forgotten memories, difficult choices, and truths buried beneath stone and silence.

Some souls seek redemption.
Others deserve condemnation.

The choice will be yours.

Lux Judicii Descendit.

Available on Steam.
